description: Export the current caved state of the mine-block model as a comma-delimited CSV. The header repeats the imported block columns and adds `HasCaved` and `CavedPeriod`, so the file can be re-imported as a block model that starts from the caved state.
notes: Not in the MassFlow manual — this command has no page in the 9.7 doc tree. Syntax below is read from the live 9.7.47 binary.
The filename is used verbatim — unlike `massflow mine-block export`, no extension is appended.
Verified on the tutorial model: the file carries `Easting,Northing,Elevation,HasCaved,CavedPeriod,BlockID,...` followed by one row per block.
